# My Media Lib

> My Media Lib is a self-hosted, private media library for audio files. The system provides backend services, administration and mobile clients, and supports streaming and offline playlists.

## Product documentation

- [Introduction](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/): Product overview and repository structure.
- [Architecture](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/architecture): System architecture and service boundaries.
- [Development Workflow](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/development): Multi-repository development and documentation workflow.

## Setup

- [Backend setup](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/setup/backend): Overview and order of the backend setup steps.
- [Backend step 1: Prepare the server](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/setup/backend/prepare-server): Deployment files, instance name, mml user and Docker.
- [Backend step 2: Certificates and keys](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/setup/backend/certificates-and-keys): TLS variants, certificates, secrets and app keys.
- [Backend step 3: Database](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/setup/backend/database): PostgreSQL and the databases of Identity and Media.
- [Backend step 4: Cache and message bus](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/setup/backend/cache-and-message-bus): Redis and RabbitMQ.
- [Backend step 5: Reverse proxy](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/setup/backend/reverse-proxy): Nginx configuration and logs.
- [Backend step 6: Identity](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/setup/backend/identity): Configuration of the Identity service.
- [Backend step 7: Media](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/setup/backend/media): Configuration of the Media service, records, sharing and federation.
- [Backend step 8: Start and first admin](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/setup/backend/start-and-first-admin): Start the backend and create the first admin.
- [Backend operations](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/setup/backend/operations): External TLS proxy, moving to another domain, PostgreSQL upgrade and CSV export.
- [Mobile app setup](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/setup/app): Build and customize the mobile client.
- [Administration app setup](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/setup/administration-app): Build and customize the desktop administration client.

## Changelogs

- [Release 4.0.0](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/changelogs/4.0.0): New features, bugfixes and breaking changes of 4.0.0 and the upgrade from 3.x.

## Concepts

- [Admins](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/concepts/admins): Administrative users and permissions.
- [Clients](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/concepts/clients): Registered devices and client applications.
- [Groups](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/concepts/groups): Group-based access to media.
- [Records](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/concepts/records): Audio records managed by the Media service.
- [Offline playlists](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/concepts/offline_playlists): Downloaded media and offline playback.
- [Federation](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/concepts/federation): Synchronization of records between partner instances.
- [Announcements](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/concepts/announcements): Messages of the admins shown in the mobile app.
- [Sharing](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/concepts/sharing): Links to searches and playbacks, download links and continuing the last playback.

## Customization

- [Fork and release](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/customize/fork-and-release): Fork setup, customization, GitHub secrets, sync workflow and renewal of signing material.
- [Administration app customization](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/customize/administration-app): Signing and release pipeline for Linux, Windows and macOS.
- [Android customization](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/customize/android): Upload keystore and release pipeline for Google Play.
- [iOS customization](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/customize/ios): Apple certificate, provisioning profile and release pipeline for the App Store.

## Contribution

- [Contribution guide](https://we-kode.github.io/mml.project/contribution): Bug reports, feature requests, and project contribution guidance.
